links.note: research/isogeny_class_ic_yield_20261102/p3_ecc2k130/PROTOCOL.md is the narrative; this file records it. Section 10 of the narrative is amendment A1: local route, isolation L0 on a loaded host, reduced scope (P3a-Y deferred), per-cell dmax accepted, at most 2 workers, clock descriptive only.

question: Do the resolving degree (Dreg), matrix shape and exact solution count of the Weil-descended m=3 decomposition system differ between the curves of the ECC2K-130 isogeny class (E0 and the 262 level-263 curves) and at a same-shape Koblitz analogue (n=43, ell=257, E0 and 258 level-257 curves), beyond the random-b null, the A/A and isomorphic-model controls and the presentation family?

claims.text: Within the measured cells the per-curve Dreg distribution of class curves lies inside the random-b null and Frobenius orbits are exchangeable (inference unit = orbit: 2 floor orbits + E0 at n=131, 6 + E0 at n=43).
claims.if_supported: null for the descended system at these cells; licensed only if the positive control (planted) is detected and iso and A/A are 100 percent identical
claims.if_not_supported: an orbit-level anomaly with its cell and attempts is reported; a whole-degree shift in every attempt is flagged exact; nothing is claimed beyond the cell

claims.text: Over the declared presentation family F (standard V in several moduli; V = span(1,g,..,g^(k-1)) in the b-adapted presentations) the minimum over F of a floor curve's Dreg equals E0's minimum over the same family (Gap < 0.5 degree), E0 minimised by the same procedure.
claims.if_supported: the standard-V gap between E0 and the floor curves is a presentation effect (outcome N)
claims.if_not_supported: outcome G (Gap >= 1 whole degree in every attempt of every floor orbit), read only through C2' after nbadapt equals the floor curves and isocheck passes; outcome U for capshit / atleast cells (bounds, never a gap)

claims.text: If a gap survives the minimum over F it is attributed to b in F_2 (the Koblitz structure of E0), not to the isogeny class or the level; nbadapt (random dense b, b-adapted presentation) must equal the floor curves for this reading. A structural statement about E0 only, not a speedup.

Yield at n=43 (P3a-Y, k=13, 100 attempts, exact solution count versus Poisson) is deferred by amendment A1: not run, no data taken, reported as not run (deferred). The solutions column of the other cells is descriptive.

No result is an improvement over the index-calculus baseline, a speedup, a gap to rho or a statement about the cost of an end-to-end ECC2K-130 attack (no S is produced); no rho reference or section 5a band applies.

hypotheses.statement: The descended m=3 decomposition system depends on the curve only through b, so within the isogeny class of ECC2K-130 (E0 and the 262 level-263 curves) and at the n=43 Koblitz analogue (E0 and the 258 level-257 curves) the resolving degree, matrix shapes and exact solution counts of class curves lie inside the random-b null and Frobenius orbits are exchangeable; the E0 versus floor-curve difference seen under the standard V is a presentation effect that disappears after minimising over the declared presentation family F.
hypotheses.mechanism: S3(a,c,d) = (a+c)^2 d^2 + acd + (ac)^2 + b: b is the only curve-dependent coefficient; b = 1 (E0) is fixed by every field isomorphism and by Frobenius and is the first basis vector of every power basis, whereas a floor curve has a dense b in a random presentation; the b-adapted presentation (modulus = minimal polynomial of b, b -> z) removes that difference.

predictions.minimum_effect: every class curve's mean Dreg differs from the random-b null mean by less than 0.5 degree in every cell that resolves (outcome resolved), and no orbit shows a whole-degree shift in every attempt

arms.description: Curve b (E0 or a class curve), random V = random k-dim F_2-subspace of F_{2^n}, random x_R, both shared by every curve of the attempt (paired); the system is built in the base modulus.

parameters.method: p3h measure (Weil-descended Semaev S4 / S3 system, Macaulay row space over F_2 in the Boolean ring)

arms.description: Random b in F_{2^n}^* (16 at n=43, 8 at n=131) from derived seeds, same V and x_R as the class curves: the right null population (every b is a valid summation system).

parameters.method: p3h measure (Weil-descended Semaev S4 / S3 system, Macaulay row space over F_2 in the Boolean ring)

arms.description: Isomorphic-model control: the Frobenius conjugate instance (b^2, V^2, x_R^2); must give identical dreg, solutions and refuted as main (expected 100 percent identical).

parameters.method: p3h measure (Weil-descended Semaev S4 / S3 system, Macaulay row space over F_2 in the Boolean ring)

parameters.method: p3h measure (Weil-descended Semaev S4 / S3 system, Macaulay row space over F_2 in the Boolean ring)

arms.description: Three liftable abscissae drawn from V, x_R = x(P1+P2+P3) on the actual curve: the planted point must satisfy all equations (planted_ok), the solver must find it (planted_found, --solve) and the refutation Dreg must not refute (outcome differs from main).

parameters.method: p3h measure (Weil-descended Semaev S4 / S3 system, Macaulay row space over F_2 in the Boolean ring)

arms.description: Presentation control: V = span(1,z,..,z^(k-1)) in the base modulus and in --presentations other irreducible moduli (b and x_R mapped by the field isomorphism).

parameters.presentations: 3 at n=43 (control cards), 2 other moduli at n=131 (3 presentations in total)

arms.description: b-adapted presentation: floor curve g = b with modulus the minimal polynomial of b, V = span(1,g,..,g^(k-1)); E0 uses the borrowed generators of the first curves of the floor orbits.

parameters.method: p3h measure (Weil-descended Semaev S4 / S3 system, Macaulay row space over F_2 in the Boolean ring)

parameters.method: p3h measure (Weil-descended Semaev S4 / S3 system, Macaulay row space over F_2 in the Boolean ring)

positive.expected_detection: planted_ok = 1 on 100 percent of planted rows and solutions >= 1 (planted_found = 1 on rows run with --solve); the planted row's refutation outcome differs from main's. Plus the standard-V presentation effect at n=131, k=6 (E0 6 vs floor 7) seen in the same run; a miss makes a null uninformative.

null_population.why_n: the n=43 population (7 units); 8 at n=131 (3 units); matched null set sizes are fixed by PROTOCOL.md section 4

seed_derivation.note: every draw is derive(seed 20261102, (n, m, k, attempt, curve) tuple) with a splitmix mixer in p3h; --seed 20261102 on every card; no seed chosen after a look

instance_sampling.rule: every curve of the two populations (263 at n=131, 259 at n=43) enumerated completely by construction; random-b nulls from derived seeds

blinding.how: p3h analyze hides arm names behind codes unless --unmask; the pooled masked analysis is produced first and --unmask is run only after it, by the main session

power.note: instances = 263 ECC2K-130 curves + 259 analogue curves; replicates = attempts (2 at n=131, 20 or 2 at n=43 by cell; the n=131 standard-V cell has 1 attempt); family = 20 Dreg-versus-null tests = (P3a k=3,4 + P3b random-V k=3,4) cells x orbit units (7 at n=43, 3 at n=131) = 2x7 + 2x3, Bonferroni alpha 0.05/20 = 0.0025, unchanged by amendment A1. Rank resolution: N+1 = 17 null curves at n=43 gives minimum p = 2/17 = 0.12 above 0.0025, so no rank rejection is claimed; the decisions are the exact integer-Dreg criteria of PROTOCOL.md section 6 (|Gap| < 0.5 degree for equivalence, a whole-degree shift in every attempt flagged exact), which do not rest on rank resolution.

primary.name: resolving degree
primary.definition: First Macaulay degree d <= dmax at which the constant 1 enters the row space (refutation) or all occurring variables are pinned; outcome resolved = a value; atleast or capshit = the bound dreg = dmax+1 (capshit = F4 size caps), never a value.
primary.source: rows jsonl fields dreg, outcome, refuted

primary.name: exact solution count per attempt
primary.definition: Exact count of x-triples (m=3) / pairs (m=2) in V with S4/S3 = 0 (n<64 library Artin-Schreier chained count; n=131 and 3k<=21 numeric); the per-attempt relation yield before lifting to points.

secondary.name: Macaulay rows
secondary.definition: Rows of the Macaulay matrix at the last degree reached.

secondary.name: Macaulay columns
secondary.definition: Columns of the Macaulay matrix at the last degree reached.

secondary.name: F4 time of the Dreg computation
secondary.definition: Single-thread (RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1) wall seconds of the Dreg computation, excluding system build; descriptive only at L0 on a loaded host.

secondary.name: system build time
secondary.definition: Single-thread seconds to build the descended system (field multiplications in the modulus; depends on the modulus weight); descriptive only.

secondary.name: solver time
secondary.definition: Seconds of solve_boolean_system on rows run with --solve; descriptive only.

secondary.name: planted point satisfies the system
secondary.definition: 1 iff the planted point satisfies every equation of the system (planted arm).

secondary.name: solver finds the planted point
secondary.definition: 1 iff the solver returns the planted point (planted arm, --solve).

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design, amended by A1: the 17 cards of PROTOCOL.md section 10 (setup, P3a main k=3,4,5, P3a controls and C2 family k=3,4, P3a m=2, P3b random V k=3,4 and 5, P3b standard V, badapt, bsparse + nbadapt, controls), with the attempts, k grids, dmax and shards written there; then stop. No sequential rule, no interim looks; no change of N, k, dmax, metric, null or threshold after data. P3a-Y is deferred: no data are taken under this protocol version, reported as not run, not dropped from the preregistration.

a cell whose rows end atleast or capshit is a bound (dreg > dmax) with its matrix shape, never a value or a gap; a cell that does not finish within its card timeout is reported as not measured, never as a bound

invalidation_rules: selftest or isocheck printing FAILED (nonzero exit), or the class reproduction differing from data/n43_l257_curves.tsv, voids the cells that use them
iso rows not 100 percent identical to main on (dreg, solutions, refuted), or A/A counts not identical, void the cell
planted_ok below 100 percent on planted rows is an instrument failure, reported first
a clock is descriptive only at L0 on a loaded host (identical counts varied up to 2.8x in the smoke); counted metrics remain

decision_rule.text: Outcomes N / G / U of PROTOCOL.md section 6.3, per (n, k) cell, inference unit = orbit, applied to counted metrics only (amendment A1: a clock never decides at L0). N: |Gap| < 0.5 degree for every orbit with the standard-V gap present in the same run (positive control seen) and iso, A/A and planted checks passed. G: Gap >= 1 whole degree in every attempt of every floor orbit, read only through C2' after nbadapt equals the floor curves and isocheck passes. U: atleast or capshit cells are bounds, never a gap. Class versus null (section 6.2): effect size with percentile-bootstrap 95 percent interval over attempts and the equivalence statement |difference| < 0.5 degree; a rejection only for a whole-degree shift in every attempt, flagged exact. Time ratios against the A/A band are reported, never decisive. A null is not an improvement over the IC baseline.
decision_rule.threshold: |Gap| < 0.5 degree (equivalence); Gap >= 1 whole degree in every attempt of every floor orbit (outcome G); Bonferroni 0.05/20 for any rank p
decision_rule.statistic: per cell, curve and attempt D(c,a) = min over the presentations of F_c of dreg; Gap(c) = mean_a D(c,a) - mean_a D(E0,a); class versus null by rank of the mean Dreg among the null curves and by the difference of means
decision_rule.interval: percentile bootstrap 95 percent over attempts (paired: the same x_R in every presentation, mapped by the isomorphism)
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: difference in mean Dreg in degrees (family minima) with bootstrap interval; whole-degree count of attempts

reading an atleast or capshit row as a Dreg value or a gap, or a card that timed out as a bound

amendments.reason: Owner decision (2026-11-02, relayed by the main session): local route, reduced scope, isolation L0 on a loaded host shared with P2 (ecbench, one core, serial) and P1 (about 2 workers). No data of this protocol exist: p3_ecc2k130/full/ does not exist; smoke/ rows are harness checks, not data.
changes: Run scope: the run_full.sh lines P3a main (k=3,4,5), P3a controls and C2 family (k=3,4), P3a m=2, P3b random V (k=3,4 and 5), P3b standard V, P3b badapt, P3b bsparse + nbadapt, P3b controls (about 10.9 CPU-hours), as 17 cards. P3a-Y (n=43, k=13 yield line, about 19.4 CPU-hours) is deferred: no data are taken for it under this protocol version, it stays in the preregistration and is reported as not run (deferred), never filled; claim C3 is therefore not run.

Per-cell dmax and attempts accepted as the builder set them (PROTOCOL.md section 5): P3a k=3 dmax 9, k=4 dmax 8, k=5 dmax 7; P3b random V k=3,4 dmax 9, k=5 dmax 7 (atleast 8); the row's own outcome decides value (resolved) versus bound (atleast, capshit); PROTOCOL.md section 10 lists which cells are expected to yield values and which bounds.

Route: local backend, no isolab-eks; isolation L0 on a loaded host; at most 2 P3 workers (two serial lanes), each single-threaded (RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1); a detached sparse git worktree pinned to the commit that files this amendment, the p3h binary copied there.

Clock descriptive only: dreg_s is the descriptive time headline (build_s reported beside it); counted metrics (dreg, outcome, rows, cols, solutions, planted_ok, planted_found) are exact and are the only ones that decide; the section 6.3 criterion 'T ratio outside the A/A band' cannot trigger outcome G at L0.

Sharding (scheduling only): attempt shards (--first-attempt, --attempts 1) for P3a main k=4, P3a controls k=4 and P3b random-V k=5; curve-index shards (--select) for P3b standard V; pooled for analysis by concatenation in card order.
Card timeouts: per command the larger of 1800 seconds and 4 times the PROTOCOL.md section 7 CPU estimate of that command.
Analysis commands (masked and unmasked analyze, pooling) are not on the cards: the main session runs them on the pooled files.
Multiplicity family stays 20 tests; the deferred P3a-Y tests (7) are not run and not removed from any divisor.
